اقتويت (form VIII)
# اِقْتَوَيْتُ (iqtawaytu) /iq.ta.waj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اِقْتَوَيْتَ (iqtawayta) /iq.ta.waj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اِقْتَوَيْتِ (iqtawayti) /iq.ta.waj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# اُقْتُوِيتُ (uqtuwītu) /uq.tu.wiː.tu/: first-person singular
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
